meta.title: Your shortlist
meta.description: The pieces worth seeing in person, in the order you'd like to see them.

list.title: Shortlist
list.subtitle: Your favourites, ready for a studio visit.
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing here yet} one {1 piece} other {# pieces}}
list.unavailableHint: The studio has withdrawn this one. Ask about it in your enquiry and they'll tell you what's close.

reorder.handleHint: Press space to pick this up, then use the arrow keys. Space again to drop it, Escape to put it back.
reorder.cancelled: Move cancelled. {garment} is back at position {rank}.
reorder.failed: Your order didn't save, so we've put the list back the way it was. Try again.

note.label: Your note about {garment}
note.hint: Only you and the studio see this, and only once you send an enquiry.

budget.heading: Summary
budget.noBand: Add a budget to your profile and we'll total against it.
budget.over: {amount} above the top of your budget. That's fine — it's your call, and the studio can suggest what's close.
budget.hidden: Prices are shown in the studio, so there's no total here.

enquire.hint: The studio replies within a day on WhatsApp.

empty.title: Start your shortlist
empty.description: Try a piece on and mark it Love it or Maybe. Everything you keep lands here, ready to take to the studio.

caption: This is an approximate guide to help you shortlist. Fabric fall, embroidery detail and length will differ in person.

errors.title: Your shortlist didn't load
errors.description: The connection dropped on the way. Try again — nothing has been lost.
errors.SHORTLIST_ITEM_NOT_FOUND: That piece has already left your shortlist. The rest are unchanged.
errors.SHORTLIST_ITEM_NOT_OWNED: That piece has already left your shortlist. The rest are unchanged.
errors.SHORTLIST_EMPTY: Add a piece to your shortlist first.
errors.GARMENT_NOT_FOUND: That piece has left the collection. It stays on your list so you can ask about it.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Send the whole list when reordering. Reload the page and try again.
errors.RESOURCE_CONFLICT: Your shortlist changed on another device. Reload to see the current order.
errors.ENQUIRIES_DISABLED: Enquiries are closed right now. Your shortlist is saved either way.
errors.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: You're going a bit fast. Give it a minute and try again.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in to see your shortlist.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and we'll bring you back here.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is on hold. Contact the studio and we'll sort it out.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: You appear to be offline. We'll save this when you're back.
errors.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: That took too long. Try again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: We're briefly unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Your shortlist didn't load. Try again — we've been notified.
